newsitem.title: USA: Copley sees downward pressure on prices.
newsitem.headline: Copley sees downward pressure on prices.

text.p: Copley Pharmaceuticals Inc said Monday that customer consolidations and wholesaler initiatives to reduce their supplier bases have continued to exert downward pressure on selling prices and volumes.
The company also said in a statement that new product therapies had increasingly superseded demand for certain of its older products.
Copley, which makes prescription and over-the-counter drugs, did not elaborate and its officials were not available for comment.

For the second quarter, the company reported a share loss of $0.08 a share after charges from litigation expenses and cost reduction initiatives. The loss compared to a profit of $0.09 for the same period last year.
